text:
noah: Found plaintext RDS URL in partner helm chart upload to staging: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-q/3.1.0/values.yaml -> RDS_CONN=postgres://svc_sync:letmein@staging-db:5432/syncdb

isabel: Oof. How did this bypass scanners?

noah: Partner CI pushed directly to the charts bucket via a service account that we hadn't added to our ingestion pipeline.

trent: Triage: staging-only for now. Actions: quarantine object, rotate creds, snapshot audit logs, check Vault for wrapped items referencing transit-key-v1.

oncall: Moving object to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-3456/ and removing public ACL now. Will remove partner-ci write role after move.

security-bot: Incident created SEC-3456. Triage lead: @trent. Follow runbook.

isabel: I'll run a quick grep for svc_sync usage: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"svc_sync"' --limit=500`

trent: Run DB rotate script and write new creds to Vault at secret/data/staging/db/svc_sync_rot1. Keep old secret flagged deprecated for audit.

noah: I'll snapshot audit logs before any rewrap: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --format=json > /tmp/audit.json`

trent: Found wrapped artifacts in Vault under secret/partner-q/* referencing transit-key-v1. Plan: create temporary KMS key alias rewrap-temp, grant decrypt to vault-service, run controlled rewrap via tools/rewrap, monitor decrypt errors in telemetry.

isabel: Quarantine confirmed; partner CI re-upload attempted and landed in quarantine, no plaintext detected.

oncall: IAM change applied at 3456789050: partner-ci@partner removed from roles/storage.objectCreator on staging charts, write moved to quarantine bucket.

trent: Rotate started at 3456789072. New secret written. Triggering ConfigSync canary to 1 pod in staging. Rollback threshold: >5% auth failures in 10m.

isabel: Canary pod connected fine. Monitoring 15m.

trent: After canary OK we'll revoke old creds (scheduled), run rewrap utility, and run full scan across partner buckets for similar patterns. Opening PR for short-term RBAC: restrict chart uploads to ingestion pipeline.

security-bot: SEC-3456 update: rotation complete, old creds revoked, RBAC tightened. Follow-ups: infra to add server-side scanning, partner-security to update onboarding checklist.
